wanted_details.caution: Vitold Viktorovich Obertas (Obertas) is a Russian intermediary for illicit DPRK financial transactions, including for Amnokgang Technology Development Company (Amnokgang). OFAC designated Amnokgang in its March 12, 2026 action. Since January 2025, Obertas has conducted nearly $2 million worth of cryptocurrency conversions, as well as at least $1.25 million in other currency transactions, for DPRK officials.

disclaimer: Vitold Viktorovich Obertas is a Russian national, not a DPRK national, and is profiled here as the intermediary the Treasury says has converted cryptocurrency and moved other currency for DPRK officials, including for Amnokgang Technology Development Company. OFAC's entry lists one Ethereum and three TRON addresses, which the scraper carries; the Ethereum address is listed for Ilya Aleksandrovich Boykov as well.

The confidence level of 'confirmed' reflects that this individual is named on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals list; a sanctions designation is an administrative action by the Treasury and not a criminal charge, and nothing here states that any court has found anything.
name_korean_not_applicable: Russian national and financial intermediary rather than a DPRK national, so no Korean rendering of the name applies.
